department: Department of Chemistry (School of Physical and Chemical Sciences)

deadline.value: The school's funded studentships close on 28 January, with the 2026 date shown, so 2027 is inferred. Self-funded applicants can apply at any point in the year.
deadline.quote: Queen Mary offers a number of university-funded studentships each year across a full range of academic disciplines. These include the waiver of tuition fees and tax-free maintenance costs. Deadline - 28th of January.

also.quote: We will accept self-funded students at any point in the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must identify a potential supervisor and contact them first. Once they agree to consider your application, you apply formally, naming the supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Before applying, you will need to identify a potential supervisor for your PhD. | Once you have contacted a potential supervisor, and they have agreed to consider your application further, you will be required to make a formal application.

funding.value: A limited number of funded projects are advertised; self-funded applicants are also accepted.
funding.quote: We have a limited number of funded projects available which are advertised on our PhD project pages.

also.quote: The Department of Chemistry offers a unique range of funded PhD opportunities for projects.

entry_route.value: A first or upper second-class honours degree in a relevant subject is needed. A master's is desirable but not always essential.
entry_route.quote: A first or upper second-class honours degree in a relevant subject area. | A masters qualification is desirable but not always essential.

notes: Application rules come from the School of Physical and Chemical Sciences pages.
